request_summary: Run the final authorized full GEC DEV suite after Azure login and Key Vault URL setup.

actions.description: Ran the full unfiltered GEC DEV suite in a fresh PowerShell process with the requested Key Vault URL and isolated fix-05 output directories.
The run completed with 51 of 52 scenarios passing; JUnit identifies the remaining FEAT_002 allCcp-off assertion failure. The six prior FEAT_006/007 ordering failures did not recur.

outcome.detail: The requested suite ran, but one scenario failed; no further rerun or fix was authorized.

friction.description: The run-local console log has mixed UTF-16/UTF-8 encoding; the failure was verified from the readable JUnit XML instead.
